title: Intrinsic free projections, constant trace and the global immersion obligation

newly_cached_primary_context.title: Injectivity on one line
newly_cached_primary_context.author: Janusz Gwozdziewicz
newly_cached_primary_context.portions_inspected: Full short HTML manuscript, especially Theorem 1.1, Lemma 2.3 and the proof through the cited Newton-polygon and line-embedding inputs.
newly_cached_primary_context.role: New HTML cache of an already retained explicit theorem: a plane Keller map injective on one affine line is invertible. The rank-two first-jet proof invokes this theorem, rather than claiming to reprove it by controls. The unchanged previously audited primary PDF remains pinned.

retained_structural_inputs.statement: Gwozdziewicz Theorem 1.1: plane Keller injectivity on one affine line gives inverse
Retained generative-polynomial and relative-closedness argument gives a common polynomial parameter for algebraically dependent plane polynomials

inspected_but_not_used.portions: Introduction and critical-point definition of Euclidean distance degree
inspected_but_not_used.reason: Generic translated-distance critical counts do not establish that translated restrictions retain unit Hessian or implement arbitrary intrinsic coefficient-pair shifts. No ED-degree theorem is imported.

direct_proof_arguments: closed base change embeds the zero-section as an actual plane in a ternary quadric level
the three helper ranks are exhausted by singularity, units, an exact smooth-quadric class lattice and plane coordinate-ring equality
at the ambient critical value the rank-two first free jet restricts the intrinsic pair to an injective affine line and the rank-one jet is already a coordinate pair
constant free frames with polynomial base offsets are covered by a literal cotangent identity, not nonlinear Hessian invariance
a different constant value leaves only a rank-one noncritical plane and explicit normal first-jet corrections
the universal compensation has exact unit-Hessian pullback but its global immersion condition excludes distinct nonzero eigenvalues of the normal first-jet matrix
determinant one and zero discriminant leave only two nilpotent-Jacobian plane cases
the retained polynomial generative theorem and parallel level lines prove the needed plane triangularity lemma directly
an explicit genuine automorphism gives unit Hessian yet a killed source tangent in the compensation map
